title: Quaint Shaggy Norwegian Potato Hash
description: A pungent and shaggy Norwegian dish featuring salted butter and ferment-jang, perfect for kids and plant-based friendly, cooked on a salt block.
instructions: Preheat the salt block in the oven at 400 degrees for 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine diced potatoes, chopped onions, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well to combine and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together melted salted butter and ferment-jang.
Add the butter and ferment-jang mixture to the potato mixture and mix until the potatoes are well coated.
Remove the preheated salt block from the oven and brush with olive oil.
Add the potato mixture to the salt block and spread out in a single layer.
Return the salt block to the oven and bake for 25 minutes or until the potatoes are golden brown.
Remove from the oven and serve hot.
